name: Pi Fail Truncated Tools
description: Settles a turn whose response was cut off by the output token limit -- every tool call in it is failed unexecuted, since its arguments may be incomplete.

properties.label: Batch terminate
properties.description: Process variable set when every tool result in the batch asked to terminate.

properties.label: Tool result count
properties.description: Process variable the number of (failed) tool results is published to.
